analysis.title: Duttenhoefer's Daily (29.10.2026)
key_insights: Market snapshot as of 29 Oct 2026: S&P 500 +28bps at 7744 (+13% ytd) on low volumes, US 10-year yield at 5.01%, Brent $114, Gold $4024, Bitcoin $80k.

Microsoft (+3% post market): 1QFY revenue of $92.3bn (+19% cc yoy) was 2% better than expected. Azure grew 48% in 1Q and Microsoft guided to 49%-50% cc growth in 2Q, with demand exceeding available supply. GS raises its price target from $640 to $700.

Alphabet (-10% post market): 3Q26 revenue $127.6bn (+25% yoy), in line with consensus. Operating income was $40.6bn vs consensus $43.4bn. Google Cloud revenue was $30.71bn (+103% yoy) with operating margin up about 1250bps yoy. Search & Other missed. GS cuts its price target from $435 to $385.
Alphabet's FY26 capex is unchanged at $195-205bn, and management said FY27 capex will increase significantly versus 2026.

ServiceNow (-18% post market): 3Q subscription revenue growth of +20.5% was 50bps above guidance and FY26 subscription guidance was maintained at 21.0% yoy cc. GS attributes the drop to elevated expectations (stock +60%+ since 2Q EPS) and a 4Q cRPO guide that decelerates to 18.5%.
Fortinet (-6% after earnings): management cited AI, SASE and network upgrades as growth drivers, with deals above $1 million in total value growing 51% in large enterprises.
Fed: the FOMC held fed funds at 3.75-4.00% with 2 votes preferring a 25bp increase. The statement kept inflation 'elevated' and upgraded economic activity to 'strong' from 'solid'.
ECB decision due 29 Oct: GS expects no change to policy language. It maintains a forecast of one more hike in December, with an additional hike in March possible if energy prices keep rising.
GS likes buying the dip in Greek banks (GSXEGRBK basket), which pulled back about 15% and sit near oversold. EPS revision breadth is close to a 5-year high.
Seasonality: November delivers roughly 10.1% of yearly buyback spend, the second strongest month after August. Year-to-date repurchase authorizations are $1341bn (+14% yoy).
The momentum basket (GSPRHIMO) tripled from the launch of ChatGPT to the late June highs and has since sold off 40%. 27 of the 39 such occurrences this year were selloffs.

AI in healthcare: GS sees AI's impact on drug development as broad across molecule design, lab optimization, manufacturing documentation, regulatory drafting and trial planning. It is bullish and focuses on the rebalanced AI Health Care Beneficiaries basket (GSHLCAIP, 30 stocks).
China: high-tech sectors contributed roughly 2% to annual real GDP growth in 2016-25, and GS expects about 2% per year in 2026-30. High-tech is 23% of GDP in 2026 vs 15% for property.
Ramp AI Index: total token spending rose 23.0% versus the same week last month.

market_movers.rationale: Solid results, Azure growth guided to 49%-50% cc in 2Q, and Copilot daily users up 50% qoq. GS raised its forecasts and target from $640.
Operating income missed consensus and Search & Other disappointed, partly offset by Cloud up 103% yoy. GS cut its estimates and target from $435.
Stock fell 18% post market on a decelerating 4Q cRPO guide of 18.5% after a 60%+ run. GS says a rerating needs stabilization in organic growth and upward estimate revisions.
Stock fell 6% after earnings. Management cited strong large-enterprise demand, with deals above $1 million growing 51%.

sector_views.rationale: Domestic balance sheets are the healthiest in over a decade, with strong EPS growth and revision breadth near a 5-year high. A 15% pullback puts the basket near oversold.
AI gains in drug development are broad across multiple steps, supporting the AI Health Care Beneficiaries basket.
GS points to its 16-stock Cyber basket (GSTMTCYB) after Fortinet's results and cites AI, SASE and network upgrades as demand drivers.

earnings_insights: Microsoft 1QFY revenue $92.3bn reported, +19% cc yoy, 2% above expectations. Azure +48% reported in 1Q, 2Q guide 49%-50% cc.

Alphabet 3Q26 revenue $127.6bn reported (+25% yoy), in line with consensus. Operating income $40.6bn reported vs consensus $43.4bn. Search & Other $63.35bn (+12% yoy), YouTube Ads $11.21bn, Google Cloud $30.71bn (+103% yoy), all reported.
ServiceNow 3Q subscription revenue growth +20.5% reported, 50bps above guidance. FY26 subscription guidance 21.0% yoy cc maintained. 4Q cRPO guide 18.5%.
Fortinet reported after the close and fell 6%. Deals above $1 million in total value grew 51% in large enterprises.
Amazon and Intel earnings are due 29 Oct.

Long-end yields remain at about 5%, a headwind for equity valuations.
High energy prices feed the ECB's possible additional hike in March.
GS expects the ECB to hold on 29 Oct, hike in December, and possibly hike again in March if energy prices rise.

macro_indicators.interpretation: A stable contribution is expected, supported by data center build-out.

tension_points.bull_case: Google Cloud grew +103% yoy with operating margin up about 1250bps yoy on enterprise AI demand, and GS sees Alphabet well positioned for AI adoption.
tension_points.bear_case: Operating income of $40.6bn missed the $43.4bn consensus, Search & Other disappointed, and FY27 capex is set to rise significantly from $195-205bn.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Further capex increases that outpace Cloud revenue growth, shown by operating income continuing to miss consensus.

tension_points.bear_case: The 4Q cRPO guide decelerates to 18.5%, an early indicator of FY27 revenue growth, after a 60%+ run in the stock.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Failure to show stabilization in organic growth and upward estimate revisions, which GS calls the clearest proofpoints for a durable rerating.
